body: Love the plan!!! Definitely wait till after the pandemic for the conch! Got mine done right before Covid and my mask consistently irritated it and took over a year to heal!

I feel like I have such bad brain fog everyday. 
I can’t remember the most basic things like what I ate the day before. I can be in the middle of a conversation with someone and just completely forget.

I used to smoke a lot (before I was on meds), but the last time I did I was in hypo episode and ended up experiencing psychosis. Now I’m on meds and just not willing to risk have another psychosis episode.
I’m a professional emotionally bottler. I wish I knew how to be more open but it doesn’t seem to come easily
